end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers using place value.
Identified digits in 2345 and wrote 2345 correctly.
Combined 6000, 40, and 2 to write 6042.
For numbers with internal zeros, wrote 400050 instead of 4050 and did not complete the expanded form.
The zero-place and spoken-part joining mix-ups remained at the last seen attempt; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value, number names, and combining thousands, tens, and ones with Diya. Diya correctly identified the digits in 2345 and formed 6042 from 6000, 40, and 2. They mixed up how to show an empty hundreds place, writing 400050 for 4050, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, practise a few numbers such as 4050 and 3060 by saying each place, writing the zero in its place, and checking the numeral against the expanded form.
